New component

<ODSProfileMenu
  trigger={
    <ODSGlobalHeaderMenuButton
      badge={<ODSBadgeIcon mode="success" />}
      icon={<ODSUser />}
      label="Label"
    />
  }
>
  <ODSProfileMenuSubComponent
    buttonLogoutProps={{
      label: "Logout",
    }}
    loggedIn
    subtitle="Username@t-online.de"
    title="Customer Center"
  >
    <>
      <ODSProfileMenuListItem
        href="#"
        icon={<ODSCreditCard />}
        label="Option"
      />
      <ODSProfileMenuListItem
        href="#"
        icon={<ODSMailOpened />}
        label="Option"
      />
      <ODSProfileMenuListItem href="#" icon={<ODSDeviceTv />} label="Option" />
      <ODSProfileMenuListItem href="#" icon={<ODSTProduct7 />} label="Option" />
    </>
  </ODSProfileMenuSubComponent>
</ODSProfileMenu>

<ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenu headerIconButtonLabel="Login">
  <ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenuHeaderContainer>
    <ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenuTitle>
      Customer Center
    </ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenuTitle>
    <ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenuSubTitle>
      Manage your contracts, bills, usage overviews, settings and more.
    </ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenuSubTitle>
  </ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenuHeaderContainer>
  <ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenuLoginButton />
  <ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenuSupport
    helpLinkHref="https://www.telekom.de/festnetz"
    registerLinkHref="https://www.telekom.de/festnetz"
  />
</ODSGlobalHeaderProfileMenu>

<ODSProfileMenu
  trigger={<ODSGlobalHeaderMenuButton icon={<ODSUser />} label="Label" />}
>
  <ODSProfileMenuSubComponent
    loggedIn={false}
    buttonLoginProps={{
      label: "Login",
    }}
    helpWithLoginLinkProps={{
      href: "https://www.telekom.de/festnetz",
      label: "Help with Login",
    }}
    registerLabel="Need an account?"
    registerNowLinkProps={{
      href: "https://www.telekom.de/festnetz",
      label: "Register now",
    }}
    subtitle="Manage your contracts, bills, usage overviews, settings and more."
    title="Customer Center"
  />
</ODSProfileMenu>
